note: BH-6976: 0 = off: STUCK_WORK_CI_TTL_S alone decides, as before BH-6976. How long a PR's cached CI line is reused when the wake feed is healthy and answered no `checks <head>` and no `pr <n>` wake since the line was written (prs_wake_seen rc 1 for both). The limit is then max(STUCK_WORK_CI_TTL_S, this). An rc 2 (the feed cannot tell) keeps STUCK_WORK_CI_TTL_S. 1-1799 reads as 1800, a non-digit as 1800. Read by _swf_ci_hit as ${STUCK_WORK_CI_QUIET_TTL_S:-1800}.
